summary: Phase 20 machine-enforces multi-pass payload provenance and lineage in verify-report. Controller review corrections closed three trust-boundary bypasses: self-authorization via result manifest, fabricated payload absent at base_commit, and fake/post-receipt result_commit. 20-case fixture test suite (all tests verify before receipt commit). All invariants documented. 20/20 PASS.
tests: python3 .bridge/tests/test_bridge_cli.py → 20/20 OK (14 original + 6 review-correction cases: self-authorization attack, fabricated payload, manifest changed unauthorized, rhino.py changed unauthorized, nonexistent result_commit, result_commit != HEAD)
notes_for_controller: All three bypasses from controller review are closed. Authorization source is now exclusively base_commit manifest. Payload fabrication (files absent at base) is rejected. result_commit must be a real git object equal to HEAD at verify time. The _example dry-run and all existing report verifications are unaffected. Known limitation: parent report presence at base_commit is used as the controller-review proxy — there is no cryptographic signature.
